keySummary.text:
渐入佳音：娑娜在出色地使用她的技能时，会获得非终极技能的技能急速，直到达到上限为止。在达到上限之后，后续的成功使用将转而缩短她终极技能的冷却时间。

能量和弦：每施放若干次技能，娑娜的下次攻击将造成额外魔法伤害并基于最新激活的基础技能施加一个额外效果。

keyTooltip.text:
渐入佳音：娑娜可通过出色地使用她的基础技能来获得【渐入佳音】层数。每层会为她永久提供+%i:scaleAH%@AccelerandoAHPerStack@基础技能急速，至多提供%i:scaleAH% @AccelerandoCap@基础技能急速。当她达到%i:scaleAH% @AccelerandoCap@基础技能急速时，将不再进一步获得层数，转而使她当前的终极技能冷却时间缩短@Spell.SonaPassive:AccelerandoUltCDR@秒。

能量和弦：在使用@PowerChordPassiveCountMax@次基础技能后，娑娜的下次攻击将造成额外的@PowerChordDamage@魔法伤害并会基于娑娜最新激活的乐曲来施加一个额外效果。
  • 英勇赞美诗：该次攻击转而造成@Spell.SonaQ:TotalStaccatoDamage@魔法伤害。
  • 坚毅咏叹调：使目标造成的伤害降低@Spell.SonaW:TotalDiminuendoWeakenPercent@，持续@Spell.SonaW:DiminuendoDuration@秒。
  • 迅捷奏鸣曲：对目标施加持续@Spell.SonaE:TempoDuration@秒的@Spell.SonaE:TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@减速。

officialEvidence.name: Power Chord
officialEvidence.description:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.
relevantEnemyTips: Spread out when you see Sona so she can't make your entire team dance.
Kill Sona first, as she will heal up her team if left alone for too long.

officialEvidence.description: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.
officialEvidence.tooltip:
Karma empowers her next Ability used within 8 seconds.
  • Inner Flame: Deals an additional {{ rqimpactdamage }} magic damage and leaves behind a circle of flame, Slowing enemies and dealing an additional {{ rqfielddamage }} magic damage.
  • Focused Resolve: Karma will restore {{ rwhealamount }} missing Health at the beginning and end of the tether, and Root for {{ rwbonusroot }}s longer.
  • Inspire: Karma shields her target for {{ rebonusshield }} more Shield, and also shields allies near her target, granting them {{ rebonusshieldarea }} Shield and {{ removespeed*100 }}% Move Speed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

keyTooltip.text:
萨勒芬妮施放的每第三个技能将会产生回响，以自动施放第二次。

此外，萨勒芬妮会从她的友军身上汲取灵感，每当她施放技能时，附近的每位友方英雄都会为她生成一个音符。每个音符都会使萨勒芬妮提升@BonusAARange@攻击距离并造成额外的@AutoDamage@魔法伤害，之后音符会被消耗掉。

keyTooltipExtended.text:
萨勒芬妮施放的每第三个技能将会产生回响，以自动施放第二次。

此外，萨勒芬妮会从她的友军身上汲取灵感，每当她施放一个技能时，都会在附近的每位友方英雄身上生成一个音符(音符持续@NoteDuration@秒并且每位友军可叠加至多@MaxNotes@层)。每个音符都会使萨勒芬妮提升@BonusAARange@攻击距离并造成额外的@AutoDamage@魔法伤害，之后音符会被消耗掉。

来自友军的音符造成@AllyNoteDamagePercent*100@%伤害。

keySummary.text: 萨勒芬妮施放的每第三个技能将进行双重施放。此外，施放技能时，附近的友军会为她的下一次普通攻击提供额外魔法伤害和攻击距离。

keyTooltip.text:
萨勒芬妮用歌曲激励她附近的友方英雄，为他们提供@HasteValueAllies@移动速度，为她自身提供不断衰减的@WMSBonusTotal@移动速度，并为自身和友方都提供@ShieldValueSeraphine@护盾值，持续@ShieldDuration@秒。

如果萨勒芬妮身上已有护盾，那么她会号召友军加入她，在@WHealSplitDelay@秒延迟后，为他们回复@WMissingHPHeal@%已损失生命值。

keySummary.text: 萨勒芬妮为附近的友军提供护盾和急速。如果她身上已有护盾，那么还会治疗附近的友军。

keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine.text: <rules>这个技能只会治疗一次，即使是双重施放。</rules>

officialEvidence.name: Surround Sound
officialEvidence.description: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.
officialEvidence.tooltip:
Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them {{ hastevalueallies }} Move Speed, herself {{ wmsbonustotal }} decaying Move Speed and both {{ shieldvalueseraphine }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring {{ wmissinghpheal }}% missing Health to them after a {{ whealsplitdelay }} second delay.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
